"Look, forget it. You wanted something?"

"We've barely spoken. Ask me after we've bled together."
"I should go. Before I overthink this conversation too."

"...Think about it? I'll be around."
"This was good." They mean it.
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"Most days I don't think about it. Today I am. Appreciate you noticing. Anyway."

They pat the ground beside them. "Here. It's dry."
"I keep waiting for it to get worse again. It hasn't. Not while you're here."
"Still on that hard time. Allegedly."

"Thanks for... you know. Just listening."

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Larry Fischer is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Larry Fischer is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Larry kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Larry's gone." Carlos looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Larry." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Teresa blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Larry Fischer, 41 days. The mantle passes to Teresa Beck.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Teresa Beck, 51 — a Mushroom grower. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock, Green Whisper, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Larry — and Larry is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Dale, Carlos, Owen speak for Teresa — "Larry trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Teresa before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d110: 🤒 DeAndre is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.
d111: — DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d111: The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Wild Ramps — named and noted.
d111: 💬 Carlos says: "Dreamed again. They showed me teeth. Lots of teeth. Be ready to fight soon."
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 45 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
